data.review_title: One star only because zero isn’t an…
data.review_text:
One star only because zero isn’t an option

Absolutely appalling service from Halara.

I placed my order on 26 June and received confirmation stating that delivery would take 5–7 business days, with a possible additional delay of 1–2 days. Based on the information provided at checkout and in the confirmation email, I reasonably expected my order to arrive by around 9 July at the latest.

Instead, it finally arrived on 21 July, more than 25 days after I placed the order. I had specifically ordered the clothes for a holiday from 12–19 July, so by the time they arrived, they were completely useless to me. Had Halara been honest about the actual timescale, I would never have placed the order.

I also spoke to a Halara customer service agent, who incredibly tried to claim that the order had arrived “on time” because it was delivered within 5–7 days of being shipped. They conveniently ignored the fact that Halara took around 20 days after I placed the order to ship it in the first place. Customers are given an expected delivery timeframe from the date they order— not from whatever date Halara eventually decides to dispatch it.

To make matters even worse, I have now discovered that I am expected to pay to return the clothes, despite only returning them because Halara failed to deliver within anything remotely close to the timeframe promised. It is outrageous that I should be left out of pocket because of their delays and poor service.

The delivery information was misleading, the customer service response was dismissive, and the overall experience has been incredibly frustrating. I certainly will not be ordering from Halara again, and I strongly advise anyone needing an order for a holiday, event or specific date to shop elsewhere.
